IaC template reference for UploaderFunction OUTPUT_BUCKET environment value
answer.explanation: Within 21:22:18-21:32:18Z, UploaderFunction failed every PutObject with NoSuchBucket (399 errors, first at 21:22:12.655, last at 21:32:18). It had no errors from 20:00 to 21:22, so the failure started abruptly. This points to a live configuration change: the OUTPUT_BUCKET environment variable now names a bucket that does not exist, while the other functions write to lambda-rca-bench-outputbucket-sglpryesfryi. The IAM role was not the cause, because the error is NoSuchBucket, not AccessDenied. The CompressionFunction AccessDenied on s3:PutObject (420 errors) stopped at 21:10:29, before the window, so it is not the cause here. Limitation: I had no tool to read the Lambda configuration or the IaC template, so the env var value and any template change are inferred from the logs and not directly confirmed.
